concept: Config rules: detect violations and auto-remediate (SSM Automation)
tests: Which combination detects noncompliant resources (e.g., public buckets) and fixes them automatically.
expected: AWS Config rules + automatic remediation actions via SSM Automation documents. Triggers: "automatically remediate noncompliant resources", "S3 buckets that become public".
why_not: CloudTrail with manual review and a weekly audit aren't automation; Inspector — vulnerabilities, not configuration compliance.
